events.title: Zoo Lights Miami
events.blurb: Zoo Miami's after-dark holiday light walk opens for the season this weekend. It runs on select nights through Dec 30.
events.blurbEs: El recorrido nocturno de luces navideñas de Zoo Miami abre la temporada este fin de semana. Funciona en noches selectas hasta el 30 de diciembre.

events.title: Luminosa: A Festival of Lights
events.blurb: A walking trail of large light installations on Watson Island. Runs nightly through Jan 10.
events.blurbEs: Un sendero a pie con grandes instalaciones de luz en Watson Island. Abre todas las noches hasta el 10 de enero.

events.title: Christmas Wonderland
events.blurb: Miami's big holiday theme park returns to Tropical Park with rides, lights and a giant observation wheel.
events.blurbEs: El gran parque temático navideño de Miami regresa a Tropical Park con atracciones, luces y una noria gigante.

events.title: Christmas Tree Lighting & Block Party
events.blurb: Coconut Grove lights its Christmas tree with a free evening block party on Fuller Street.
events.blurbEs: Coconut Grove enciende su árbol de Navidad con una fiesta callejera gratuita en Fuller Street.

events.title: Guaco
events.venue: The Fillmore Miami Beach at The Jackie Gleason Theater
events.blurb: The Venezuelan band Guaco plays the Fillmore Miami Beach.
events.blurbEs: La banda venezolana Guaco se presenta en The Fillmore Miami Beach.

events.title: Aitana: Cuarto Azul World Tour
events.venue: The Fillmore Miami Beach at The Jackie Gleason Theater
events.blurb: Spanish pop singer Aitana brings her Cuarto Azul World Tour to Miami Beach.
events.blurbEs: La cantante pop española Aitana trae su Cuarto Azul World Tour a Miami Beach.

events.title: Nick Cannon Presents: Wild 'N Out Live
events.blurb: The improv comedy and freestyle battle show from TV comes to the stage downtown. Doors at 6:30 p.m.
events.blurbEs: El show de comedia improvisada y batallas de freestyle de la tele llega al escenario en el centro. Puertas a las 6:30 p.m.

events.title: Miami Hurricanes vs. Boston College
events.blurb: The Canes close the regular season at home against Boston College.
events.blurbEs: Los Canes cierran la temporada regular en casa contra Boston College.

events.title: Miami Dolphins vs. New York Jets
events.blurb: The Dolphins host their AFC East rival Jets. Kickoff time may change under NFL flexible scheduling.
events.blurbEs: Los Dolphins reciben a sus rivales de la AFC Este, los Jets. La hora puede cambiar por la programación flexible de la NFL.
